messages.subject: legend for geom_vline
parts:
Hi Folks,

I'm having trouble getting geom_vline to produce a legend for the different colors below.  I'm not sure what I'm doing wrong.  I've tried adding color_scale_hue, but it doesn't seem to have helped.  Any help is greatly appreciated!

Thanks,
Allie


test_df1 = data.frame(
              date = seq(from=as.Date(Sys.time()), by=1, length.out=100),
              y = rnorm(100))

test_df2 = data.frame(
              date = seq(from=as.Date(Sys.time()+1), by=5, length.out=15),
              col = factor(round(runif(15)*10)))

ggplot(data=test_df1, aes(x=date, y=y)) + geom_line(color="red") +
    geom_vline(data=test_df2, aes(xintercept=date, color=col))

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: legend for geom_vline
parts:
Hi, 

use:

geom_vline(..., show_guide = TRUE)



2012年4月19日10:05 Alexander Shenkin <ashe...@ufl.edu>:

test_df1 = data.frame(
              date = seq(from=as.Date(Sys.time()), by=1, length.out=100),
              y = rnorm(100))

test_df2 = data.frame(
              date = seq(from=as.Date(Sys.time()+1), by=5, length.out=15),
              col = factor(round(runif(15)*10)))

ggplot(data=test_df1, aes(x=date, y=y)) + geom_line(color="red") +
    geom_vline(data=test_df2, aes(xintercept=date, color=col))

Thanks Kohske, that solves the problem.

Now, when I try to add the scale_color_brewer(pal = "Set1") to it, I get the following error:

Error in scale_map.discrete(scale, df[[j]]) : 
  attempt to apply non-function

Any idea what's going on with this?  Seems like Wickham's ggplot2 book suggests that that color scale should work for discrete values.

Thanks again,
Allie
